description: Sent to Koomyo with the return. Empty means Other.
label: Reason For Koomyo
name: Purchase Receipt-koomyo_return_reason

description: Empty: not sent. Adjustment: breakage or found stock. Waste: spoilage or a staff meal (the reason comes from the Waste Map). Supply issue: soap, gloves. Never for sales: Koomyo takes sales off stock itself. Needs Send Stock Changes to Koomyo on the connection.
label: Send To Koomyo As
name: Stock Entry-koomyo_send_as

description: Starts, fills and closes a count in Koomyo for each warehouse on the Branch Map (needs Send Stock Changes to Koomyo on the connection). A closed count cannot be undone there.
label: Send To Koomyo As A Stock Count
name: Stock Reconciliation-koomyo_send

description: Makes this Item an ingredient in Koomyo when saved (needs Send Items and Warehouses to Koomyo on the connection). Opening stock is never sent: make a stock adjustment.
label: Send To Koomyo As
name: Item-koomyo_send_as

description: Needed only when more than one connection sends Items.
label: Koomyo Connection To Send To
name: Item-koomyo_target

description: Makes this Warehouse in Koomyo when saved and adds it to the Branch Map (needs Send Items and Warehouses to Koomyo on the connection).
label: Send To Koomyo As A Warehouse
name: Warehouse-koomyo_send
